name: PLANNING COMMISSION
agenda_text:
PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday DECEMBER 13, 2018
7:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair French
Commissioner Avery, Olvera, and Ward
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meetings of October 11, 2018, and November 8, 2018
11/8/18 Minutes
10/11/18 Minutes
8. Public Hearings
8A. Conditional Use Permit 09-10 Time Extension No. 1
Virtual Site Walk, Applicant
(Continued from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of November 8, 2018)
A request to approve the first 10-year time extension to Conditional Use Permit 09-10 for the operation of an existing minor communications facility located at 2531 Olive Drive.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission approve Conditional Use Permit 09-10 Time Extension No. 1 and find that the project will not result in any changes to the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
CUP 09-10 TE No. 1
8B. Conditional Use Permit 14-017 Time Extension
McClean Properties, Applicant
(Continued from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of November 8, 2018)
A request for a two-year time extension for the construction of an assisted living/memory care facility located approximately 500 feet west of Division Street and 700 feet north of Rancho Vista Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-036 approving CUP 14-017 TE and find that the project is consistent with the Mitigated Negative Declaration and the Mitigation Monitor and Reporting Program. Justin Sauder, Assistant Planner
CUP 14-017 TE
8C. Tentative Parcel Map 73299 Time Extension
Palmdale Corporate Center I, LLC, Applicant
A request to extend the approval of Tentative Parcel Map 73299 for three years to subdivide one lot into two lots located north of Auto Center Drive, west of Trade Center Drive.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission approve Tentative Parcel Map 73299 Time Extension and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
TPM 73299 TE
8D. Conditional Use Permit 18-011
Thanos Fitness, Applicant
A request to establish a fitness center use within an existing tenant space located at 844 West Palmdale Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-038 approving a fitness center use and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
CUP 18-011
9. Staff Communications Development Updates
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
10. Planning Commission Communications
11. Adjournment to the regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, January 10, 2019, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber
